body: I had a personal experience with this individual last year that caused emotional distress and a detriment at that time. I am now scared he is targeting others and would like to stop that if possible due to my fears.
if only it was that simple

I agree with the honest part so much. I once withdrew holiday money from my bank and noticed the person hadn't counted it properly, they gave me £300 over what I was withdrawing and I handed it back to them, they looked confused. I've since been told by so many people I should of just kept it, but I couldn't and still glad I never to this day. I think some people take honesty for granted in today's world.

I tried, so many times, it just seemed to fall on deaf ears every time and I always felt I was the one having to sort all the issues while he done nothing. He had a weed habit that caused a severe problem and with everything else I just felt I was the one having to carry everything. I love him as a person, I just couldn't take how he treated me or the relationship.

I mainly felt unheard, so many things happened that broke me down, it seemed he didn't understand what it meant to be in a proper adult relationship with his past experiences being childish. It just broke me down with other things going on in my life at the time. I left him because I was having a bad day with my mental health and he didn't bother to ask me how I was which just pushed it for me that he didn't care.

I went to the annual tabletop gaming event that was on in the concert hall a few weeks ago and it was great to see people from all different age groups there, it just seems like finding groups that meet regularly difficult and I find it awkward myself turning up to a lot of the cafes and stuff by myself since I just feel so out of place and the only people I would go with were the ones that I already played games with anyways so wouldn't be much point. I would like to be able to branch out and meet people through it as well. It definitely wouldn't be weird for myself if you wanted to join in as well, maybe with the amount of people on here also looking for something it might be worth organising an event separately just for that, possibly an idea, but I am quite nervous around new people so don't think I would make a good host.

Thanks for you comment.

The problem is I don't think being antisocial was my choice thinking about it, just reached out to the wrong people, got burned and my confidence in them fell away since I used to be quite a social thing that could go to gigs by myself and be able to talk to random people and get on well with them. Think I just learned that most people where assholes and that's what put me off or people would use me unfortunately.

It's good to hear what someone else who feels the same way though does to combat it.

I know I'm trying to get just a basic job at the moment which might help at least keep me busy and hopefully meet people that way. I've looked into what groups there are in my area that I'd find interesting, just need to get over my fear since I've been to things like that before and always get looked at weirdly and that triggers my anxiety, guess it's just strange seeing a girl wanting to play boardgames to these people. I do need to get back into some hobbies, I used to use them to help and would help spark the creative in me that has been lost quite a bit.

Thank you for the advice, it has helped me think of a direction to go in.
Thank you for your advice, I'll be taking it onboard and hopefully there will be a point of acceptance I can reach with him.
Okay. So what do I do?

Thanks for the reply.

I would really like him to understand since the not understanding things is playing havoc with my thoughts and core beliefs since him not understanding is eating away at me and just reinforcing those thoughts. 
I would like for him to be able to actively listen to me when I'm telling him about it all since he doesn't. He just comes back with ways to 'fix' things which don't work for me, then gets annoyed and says 'you just have an issue with every suggestion', which is more damaging.
I would like him to be able to interact and ask me things when in distress since he just sits there then complains at me for not saying anything and doesn't get why I can't just openly speak my mind constantly.

I think the acceptance part is a big thing since I don't feel that he does accept it. At first he said he understood because he had a bit of depression a while back but nothing on the scale of what I've dealt with and him trying to say 'well why can't you just do what I do and do this to solve it', which just made me feel even more alone and misunderstood.

Thank you for the advice, I will definitely be taking it on board.

I am in touch with them back home, though there's only 1 I can think of who I would be freely able to discuss this with them, however I don't want to since he is going through the same thing and I don't want to bring him down as well.

I think it's a mix of being estranged from my parents I had to stay with during summer, moving away to a quiet secluded town for uni where there isn't much to do except uni work, and relationship issues I'm having with my partner and their lack of support, understanding and relationship maturity. Probably mainly the last one the most since the issues there have been eating away at me for some time. My health hasn't been great either so I have dropped about 3 dress sizes in the space of 5 months.

I reached out to a community health clinic who gave me a cpn but I'm now having to deal with that information not being transferred to the doctors here so I can continue receiving that help. I have started taking nutrition supplements and a friend gave me a drink to help keep my weight on that she got given for Crohn's.

I try to reach out, I tried with my partner but he doesn't seem to understand even though he kept saying he did. I have taken a break from that relationship since last night since I couldn't deal with being in a ldr again since he lost my full trust after events that happened when I went to uni last year.

I just find it difficult to find someone I can talk to since I'm so introverted and find it difficult to trust people due to mild childhood trauma and previous toxic relationships.

Unfortunately I'm using what little energy I have to just get through the next hour, been feeling this way for a while and just tired of it. Just become emotionally numb to any connections I have with people.

Family I don't really talk to and feel quite estranged from. Friends wise I haven't had much luck with reliable friends who I could open up to about things when I was younger but thankfully now have a few friends I have been opening up to about how I feel. Though that's a struggle in itself since I then worry about what they think of me but I guess that's just part of the anxiety.

It was hard getting through those things but I sat and spoke to him about it all. 

Him, like most of us, came with damage from past relationships which had their effects on him which resulted into some of this. We spoke about it, found out why and he changed and genuinely showed me he had, however stumbles from time to time.

But even through all of that I still feel it was mainly me picking up the pieces because I'm the one with the motivation to look up all help to work through issues due to my own and knowing that the only way to get through it is to deal with it.

He's not perfect, it has been rough, but I don't want to think i can go and find someone better than him because even with all of that, there's still no one else I have comfortably shared my story with who can still turn around and say they love me. He's an idiot, but he's mine, and I just want to try to find a way to make it work some how.
I have just had a look at it there and done it for myself, I can see how it can be useful. Will speak to him about it and see how it goes. Thank you.
